name: Home accessories (HomeKit and Matter)
plain: Reads and controls the person's smart home: lights, locks, cameras.
meaning: Shows when people are home, which doors are locked and camera feeds; it can also control physical devices.

android.permission: No dedicated permission; Google Home APIs use OAuth, Matter commissioning via Play services
android.prompt_ui: Google account consent plus commissioning sheet
android.persistence: Until revoked in the Google Home account settings
android.store_policy: Google Home developer review for Home APIs
android.note: No OS level home store; control goes through Google Home account

ios.prompt_ui: Allow or Don't Allow access to your home data

limits.headline: Can see and control your smart home devices, only after you allow it
limits.user_action: You tap Allow when the app asks for your home data, or approve a Google Home sheet
can: List your lights, locks, cameras and sensors
Turn devices on or off, lock doors, and change settings
Tell who or what is home based on your devices
Add a new device while you approve a setup sheet
cannot: Control the home before you allow it
See devices in homes you did not share with it
Reach your Android smart home without your Google account consent (Android)
limits.differs: iPhone keeps a home list on the phone. Android has no such list, so control goes through your Google Home account.

story.what_it_is: Lets an app see and control your smart home: lights, locks, cameras and sensors.

marketing.name: HomeKit and Matter
marketing.pitch: Control lights, locks and cameras from one app, with end to end encryption and local control.

story.for_you: You tap Allow once and then the app can turn your lights on, lock the front door or show a camera. You also see your home status on your lock screen and in Siri.
story.for_makers: Makers of smart home gear use it so their device works with the whole Apple home, not only their own app. It sells hardware and lets apps add routines like 'good night' that touch many brands at once.

use_cases.example: Tap 'Good night' and every light turns off, the door locks and the thermostat drops to 68 degrees.
A doorbell camera app shows who is at the door and lets you unlock the lock remotely for a delivery.
A thermostat app learns when you leave, using the phone's home status, and saves energy while you are out.
A sleep sensor app dims the bedroom light and starts a white noise machine when it detects you lying down.
A parent sets the smart plug on a tablet charger to switch off at bedtime.
Someone with limited mobility controls blinds, door and lights with their voice instead of reaching for switches.

story.android_note: Android uses Google Home and Matter instead of HomeKit, with Matter as the shared standard.
story.ios_note: HomeKit is deeply built into iOS, and Matter devices can be added to it.

technical_bounds: Android has no per app OS level permission for homes
Cloud APIs need account linking; local APIs need local network permission

history.change: Home APIs and Matter commissioning keep expanding through Play services (GA timing from vendor posts)
